<style>
  body { font-family: Segoe UI, Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif; margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #f5f5f5; }
  .main { max-width: 820px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 2em 1.5em; background: #ffffff; }
  .phishHeader { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1.5em; }
  .phishHeader > div { min-width: 280px; }
  .headerContent { flex-grow: 4; }
  .heroImage { text-align: center; flex-grow: 1; max-width: 420px; }
  .heroImage img { width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; }
  .logoDropdown { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
  .companyLogo { width: 15em; }
  .companyLogo img { height: 5em; max-width: 100%; }
  .subHeader { font-size: 1.75em; margin-top: 1em; line-height: 1.3; color: #1a1a1a; }
  .header { font-size: 2em; margin-top: 0.8em; line-height: 1.2; color: #1a1a1a; }
  .subText { font-size: 1em; margin-top: 0.8em; line-height: 1.6; color: #444444; }
  .tipsSection { margin-top: 2.5em; padding: 1.5em; background-color: #f0f0f0; border-radius: 8px; border-left: 4px solid #7B1FA2; }
  .tipsTitle { font-size: 1.4em; color: #333; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.8em; }
  .tipItem { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 0.8em; }
  .tipIcon { color: #7B1FA2; font-size: 1.2em; margin-right: 0.6em; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 2px; }
  .tipText { font-size: 0.95em; color: #333; line-height: 1.5; }
  .emailPreview { margin-top: 2em; padding: 1.5em; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 8px; background: #fafafa; }
  .emailPreviewTitle { font-size: 1.1em; font-weight: 600; color: #555; margin-bottom: 1em; }
  .disclaimerText { font-size: 0.8em; color: #888; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 0.5em; margin-bottom: 1em; }
  .navButtons { margin: 2em auto 1em; border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; box-sizing: border-box; text-align: center; width: 85%; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.5em 2em; background: #fafafa; }
  .navButtonRow { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 1.5em; margin-top: 1em; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .navButton { display: inline-block; padding: 0.7em 2em; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; }
  .navButtonPrimary { background-color: #7B1FA2; color: #ffffff; }
  .navButtonSecondary { background-color: #e8e8e8; color: #333333; }
  .footer { margin-top: 2em; padding-top: 1.5em; border-top: 1px solid #e0e0e0; text-align: center; }
  .footerText { font-size: 0.8em; color: #999; margin-top: 0.5em; }
  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .phishHeader { flex-direction: column; }
    .heroImage { max-width: 100%; }
    .subHeader { font-size: 1.4em; }
    .header { font-size: 1.6em; }
    .navButtons { width: 95%; padding: 1em; }
  }
</style>

<div class="main">

  <div class="phishHeader">
    <div class="headerContent">
      <div class="logoDropdown">
        <div class="companyLogo">
          <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Mubadala Energy">
        </div>
     
      </div>

      <div class="subHeader">
        ${userName}, you were just <b style="color: #C50F1F;">phished</b> by your security team.
      </div>
      <div class="header"><b>It's okay! You're human. Let's learn from this.</b></div>
      <p class="subText">
        Rather than stealing your login credentials like a cyber criminal, we have redirected you to this educational page instead and assigned you some training courses.
      </p>
    </div>
    <div class="heroImage">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Phishing Awareness">
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="tipsSection">
    <div class="tipsTitle">⚠ Tips to identify phishing messages</div>

    <div class="tipItem">
      <span class="tipIcon">✔</span>
      <span class="tipText"><strong>Check the sender's email domain carefully.</strong> Attackers use lookalike domains such as "mubadale-energy.com" or "mubadala-energy.ae" instead of the real corporate domain. A single letter difference is all it takes.</span>
    </div>

    <div class="tipItem">
      <span class="tipIcon">✔</span>
      <span class="tipText"><strong>Be suspicious of urgency and threats.</strong> Phrases like "your account will be suspended", "process today", or "within 24 hours" are designed to make you act before you think.</span>
    </div>

    <div class="tipItem">
      <span class="tipIcon">✔</span>
      <span class="tipText"><strong>Never enter your credentials via an email link.</strong> If a portal asks for your Microsoft 365 or corporate login, navigate to it directly through your browser or bookmarks instead of clicking the link.</span>
    </div>

    <div class="tipItem">
      <span class="tipIcon">✔</span>
      <span class="tipText"><strong>Verify banking or payment changes out of band.</strong> If a vendor or colleague asks you to update banking details or process a payment, confirm by calling them on a known phone number, not by replying to the email.</span>
    </div>

    <div class="tipItem">
      <span class="tipIcon">✔</span>
      <span class="tipText"><strong>Hover over links before clicking.</strong> On desktop, hover your mouse over any link to see the actual URL in the bottom-left of your browser. If the domain does not match who the email claims to be from, do not click.</span>
    </div>

    <div class="tipItem">
      <span class="tipIcon">✔</span>
      <span class="tipText"><strong>Report suspicious emails.</strong> Use the "Report Message" button in Outlook or forward the email to your IT Security team. Reporting helps protect everyone in the organization.</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="emailPreview">
    <div class="emailPreviewTitle">📩 The phishing email you received :</div>
    <div class="disclaimerText">
      DISCLAIMER: The message you clicked on is a phishing simulation. It is not a real message from the owner of the trademark or logo featured in the simulation. The trademarks and logos featured are the property of their respective owners and are in no way associated with this simulation, nor have the owners authorized or endorsed their use in the simulation.
    </div>
    <div>${emailAddress}</div>
  </div>

  <div class="navButtons" style="${showGoToTrainingButtonContent}">
    <div style="font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.1em; color: #333;">
      We have assigned you training to learn how to spot phishing in the future.
    </div>
    <div class="navButtonRow">
      <a href="${TrainingURL}" class="navButton navButtonPrimary" rel="noopener" target="_self">
        Go to training
      </a>
      <a href="${AddToCalendarLink}" class="navButton navButtonSecondary" rel="noopener" target="_self">
        Add to calendar
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="footer">
    <div>
      </div></div></div>
